summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing technical issues and analytics data for multiple regions. First, a map display issue was identified in the asset manager; [p1] confirmed that viewing it on the production environment revealed the problem, necessitating deployment of recent fixes.

Separately, [p1] found an error in impressions and planned to recalculate the data using the staging environment for Lithuania. If successful, this corrected data would be deployed to production, resolving the issue for Finland as well.

Regarding a dashboard visualization (a 'donut chart'), [p2] provided updated figures without a text summary on the left, confirming that the numbers were accurate. When discussing aesthetics, [p1] requested different colors for the chart segments, while [p2] offered to adjust them or revert to previous color schemes.
decisions: The map display issue requires deploying recent fixes to production.
Impression data must be recalculated on staging using Lithuania's data before deployment to production (which will fix Finland).
A donut chart visualization was updated with accurate figures, and the color scheme needs adjustment.
action_items: Recalculate impression data for Lithuania on staging.
Adjust the colors of the donut chart visualization.
